We also have basic medical supplies at reception. The nearest hospital is in Modica, about 35 minutes away.
</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Are there shops or restaurants nearby?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, there are bars, restaurants, and supermarkets just a few minutes away. For a more authentic experience, we can recommend the best local options. To reach the nearest restaurants, you will need a car, but don’t worry—you can request our taxi or rental service, or simply enjoy Floripa’s homemade cuisine. Our chef will delight you daily with à la carte lunches and buffet-style dinners, with wine included.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Can I add extras on arrival?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Absolutely—visit reception any time and we&#x27;ll be happy to set you up with additional activities. </p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Can I get a discount if I pay in cash?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes! If you pay the total amount in cash (including extras), you’ll receive a 5% discount. There is an ATM in Pozzallo, 6 km from Floripa.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Can I reach Floripa using public transport?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, you can take a train or bus to Ispica, from where we can arrange a transfer for you.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Does Floripa organize excursions or tours?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We are happy to recommend the best experiences in the area! You can do it once on site. But if you prefer having everything set before-hand, feel free to send us an email at welcome@floripa.it.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Do I need to bring my yoga mat?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">You do not need to bring your mat - as we have fully furnished Yoga shalas with all props. For just €10, we will take care of all your laundry</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Do you offer options for guests with dietary restrictions?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, we can accommodate vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free diets. Please let us know in advance so our kitchen can cater to your needs.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">How can I book my stay?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">You can book directly on our website or contact us by email for personalized assistance. To reserve your room, simply use the booking bar at the bottom of our page www.floripa.it
Select your dates, and in the next window you’ll be able to choose your preferred room among those still available. The room rate includes your chosen accommodation, breakfast, and a yoga package (which includes two yoga classes per day). If you’d like to add another package, simply select “Yoga package for second guest.”
On this page, you can also book one of our packages, which include various additional services. Otherwise, you can reserve any extras directly onsite. The system does not charge your credit card—it only stores your details securely. You can settle the full balance once you arrive at the property.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">How can I pay during my stay?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We accept cash, Visa, and MasterCard (American Express not accepted).</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">I have never tried kitesurfing. We offer courses for all levels, from beginners to advanced riders, with certified IKO instructors.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">I&#x27;m a beginner/advanced. Can I join the yoga classes?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Absolutely! Classes are open to everyone, from beginners to advanced practitioners, and you’ll always find a way to deepen your practice at your own level.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">I&#x27;m a solo traveler, will it be easy to meet people? </div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes! It will be extremely easy! Most of our guests come around on their own, and even our staff members (and dogs) are super friendly, so you will not feel lonely!</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Is breakfast included in the room rate?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, breakfast is included in all rates and is served buffet-style from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Is there a minimum length of stay?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">To create a community feeling where everyone has time to get to know each other, the minimum booking length is 3 nights. In August, the minimum booking length is 7 nights in a private room and 4 nights in a shared room.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Is Wifi available ?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, Wifi is free and available throughout the property. We apologize if the connection is sometimes unstable - our area is still quite rural, and occasional Wi-Fi drops can happen. </p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What does the basic package include ?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">The room (solo or shared) + two yoga classes a day + daily breakfast + chair and umbrella at Zuma Beach</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What is the best time of year to visit Floripa?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">loripa is open from late March to early November. The best months for kitesurfing are from May to October, while yoga is practiced year-round, with ideal conditions in spring and autumn. The season varies a lot—if you’re looking for an escape from the city chaos and a pure immersion in unspoiled nature, we recommend April, May, and October. If you’re seeking energy, vitality, and new connections, the Sicilian summer won’t disappoint!</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What is the nearest airport?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">The closest airports are Catania (about 1.5 hours by car) and Comiso (about 1 hour by car).</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What is your cancellation policy?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We offer different flexible options. We recommend checking our booking page or contacting us for more details.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What&#x27;s the average age of guests ?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We are happy to welcome guests of every age to Floripa but the average age is around 35.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What types of accommodation do you offer?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We have private rooms, bungalows, and dorms, all carefully furnished to ensure comfort and relaxation in a Balinese-inspired style. All accommodations overlook our beautiful garden, where the vibrant colors of our flowers will amaze you.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What types of yoga classes do you offer?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We offer Vinyasa, Yin, Hatha, and other practices, with experienced teachers who tailor sessions to all levels. Additionally, you will also have the opportunity to join extra workshops, rituals and practices. Check out the section “Floripa Yoga Academy” to discover more.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-questions w-dyn-item"><div class="faq10_accordion"><div data-w-id="f4ea4207-bc42-985f-52e3-9e4c82fd6e02" class="faq10_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Where is Floripa Yoga &amp; Kitesurf located?</div><div class="faq10_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div class="faq10_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Floripa is located in Santa Maria del Focallo, a village in the south-east corner of Sicily, just a few steps from one of the island’s most beautiful beaches.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="margin-top margin-xxlarge"><div class="text-align-center"><div class="max-width-medium align-center"><div class="margin-bottom margin-xsmall tablet-text-align-center"><h3 class="heading-style-h4">Still have questions?</h3></div><p class="text-size-regular margin-bottom text-align-center">We&#x27;re happy to help!</p><div class="button-group is-center margin-0"><a href="mailto:welcome@floripa.it" class="button w-button">Contact</a></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><div class="cta-section-light"><div class="container"><div data-w-id="02ff57dc-ff6f-3b07-4638-b760b10a9cd9" class="title-wrap remove-padding"><h1 class="h1-cta">The Perfect Restorative Holiday</h1><a href="https://floripa.beddy.io/#/(beddy:home)?lang=en" target="_blank" class="button button-space-top w-button">Book Your Stay</a></div></div></div><section class="section_gallery9"><div class="padding-global"><div class="container-large"><div class="padding-section-large"><div class="gallery9_component"><div class="margin-bottom margin-xxlarge"><div class="text-align-center"><div class="max-width-large-70 align-center"><h2 class="heading-style-h2 text-align-center">We&#x27;re Also Animal Lovers</h2><p class="text-size-regular text-align-center">At Floripa, our love extends beyond people to our furry friends.
